hint.en: For a fire-and-forget occurrence with no start/end pair — a doorbell press, a single motion pulse, a button click. Just tallies how many times it happened, no duration or energy. Run once to set it up (or wire it to a native trigger — running it again on the same name updates the existing counter instead of duplicating it), then use "Log binary event" wherever the real occurrence happens.
Pick an existing counter to update it, or type a new name and pick "Create new" to make one.
